name: Mill
rules: 1 VP, and +2 more income (+3 in all).
notes: Economy. Was 0 VP and never built in simulation; now 1 VP. Income already runs high (open question 33); watch it.

name: Wharf
rules: Needs 2+ canals on its borders. When built, 1 money per canal on its borders.
notes: Rewards busy junctions. Never VP per canal: digging must not raise the Dig lane's own multiplicand (scoring.md).

name: Inn
rules: +1 VP at game end per building next to it, anyone's, up to +2.
notes: Clustering. Capped at +2 after simulation: its bonus is building score, which brown cards multiply.

name: Logging camp
rules: Forest only. Puts 4 wood on its hex: anyone may haul it, paying you 1 a cube.
notes: From the source notes. Any other building on a forest uses up the wood.

name: Quarry
rules: Mountain only. Puts 4 stone on its hex: anyone may haul it, paying you 1 a cube.
notes: From the source notes. Yield 3 at first; raised to 4, with a coastal mountain at 0,4, after simulation found stone always imported.

name: Clay pit
rules: Clay bed only. Puts 4 clay on its hex: anyone may haul it, paying you 1 a cube.

name: Digging camp
rules: Your digs that touch this hex (share a corner with it) cost 1 less. One per player.
notes: The notes' digging camp gave dig range; without range it becomes a local discount. One per player after simulation.

name: Surveyor's office
rules: No VP. +1 hand size for the rest of the game (up to the cap).
notes: From the notes: strong, so costly and one per player. The only hand size outside the +1S discovery.

name: Transport hub
rules: An inland port: imported cubes can be hauled from here instead of a harbour. Others pay you 1 a cube.
notes: The notes' transport hub cut haul costs; with cubes it brings the import market inland.
